palette_provenance: Not project-native and not a library preset: brand_extract.py found no colors on the GitHub repo (no project site), and a second pass on the creator's dev.to profile returned only dev.to's own platform chrome (a gray #848484 profile default), not an identity. With nothing to mine, a designed 'amber ledger' palette was assembled to fit the project's plain-text/markdown/log identity -- a warm amber-phosphor accent (the light that stays on) on a near-black canvas. Steered warm deliberately: accent hue 36 sits >= 60 off both recent accents (07-06 #1fb6ff hue 200 cool, 07-07 #CBA0FF hue 267 cool) AND flips temperature cool->warm, clearing the color anti-repeat two ways. URLs tried: https://github.com/OthmanAdi/planning-with-files (no colors), https://dev.to/othmanadi (platform chrome only).

readability.accent_ink_note: renderer derives --accent-ink (amber blended to ~205 luma) for text-scale accent; raw #FFB13C (luma ~185) kept for dots/fills/glows.
readability.muted_content_note: activity/detail lines use --muted-content; raw ink_muted only for decorative tags.
per_scene_light_source: s1 object: bright amber database glyph + serif label (the name, the poster)
s2 three_line: three bright serif lines, accent third line
s3 panes: bright file names + state dots on the three cards
s4 metaphor: bright accent network converging on a glowing core
s5 flash: full white-out field (brightest beat, the /clear)
s6 morph money: bright 'still there' scaling in with a bloom
s8 object: bright glyph again, rhyming the open
inverted_beats: s5 flash (full bright field, dark ink -- the /clear white-out)
readability.brightness_plan: The shader amber field lifts every frame above the mean-luma floor by construction (measured lift on prior shader runs 37->111). Two explicit bright beats -- the /clear white-out and the count-up -- give a color script, not one dark wash. A near-black canvas earns its brightness rather than hoping the grade lifts it.
readability.color_anti_repeat: accent hue 36 (warm amber) vs 07-06 (#1fb6ff hue 200 cool) and 07-07 (#CBA0FF hue 267 cool): >= 60 off both AND a temperature flip cool->warm AND large delta-E. Within the runtime, the amber field vs the white-out flash gives a value/temperature beat.
